title: Start the run

request.details: After writing instructions, POST allow_instruction_ai=false. Use true if AI authoring of an instruction is intended.

response: The draft is confirmed and the full run starts or resumes. manual_write_wait in waiting means no AI is assigned to a role. Check wait_reason and intervention via cards/state later. Run completion does not wake this chat automatically.
errors: On 409 chat_run_instruction_missing fill the missing instructions. On 403 chat_edit_mode_required check the applied chat mode.
